title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 experts: home (3.25 bpw) at TP=4, TP=5 and TP=6, bit225 (2.25 bpw) at TP=3
summary: Full GLM 5.3 on gr8, a from-scratch CUDA engine with no vLLM, PyTorch or NCCL at serve time. Up to 8 requests decode at once, with DFlash2 or MTP drafting chosen each round at TP=4, prefix reuse, and context-parallel KV. Boots from one Hugging Face release.

configs.label: TP=4
configs.notes: RigMark 1.0.0, reasoning_effort low, GPU clocks uncapped (full application clock; the 2200 MHz cap is only for PR-to-PR gate comparisons), booted from the Hugging Face release with the launcher defaults. Mean of two fresh boots on 2026-10-24; temperature-0 replies identical across the two, smoke 14/14. Structured output is not reported: it measures predictable output, not agent speed. DFlash2 drafter (--drafter). With --kv-format int4 (experimental, about 3% slower decode) the KV pool is 513,536 tokens.

configs.label: TP=3
configs.notes: bit225 experts (about 2.25 bpw), MTP only. RigMark 1.0.0, reasoning_effort low, GPU clocks uncapped (full application clock; the 2200 MHz cap is only for PR-to-PR gate comparisons), booted from the Hugging Face release with the launcher defaults. Mean of two fresh boots on 2026-10-24; temperature-0 replies identical across the two, smoke 14/14. Structured output is not reported: it measures predictable output, not agent speed. With --kv-format int4 (experimental) the KV pool is 410,624 tokens, an estimate not yet booted.

configs.label: TP=6
configs.notes: MTP only. RigMark 1.0.0, reasoning_effort low, GPU clocks uncapped (full application clock; the 2200 MHz cap is only for PR-to-PR gate comparisons), booted from the Hugging Face release with the launcher defaults. Mean of two fresh boots on 2026-10-24; temperature-0 replies identical across the two, smoke 14/14. Structured output is not reported: it measures predictable output, not agent speed. One of the six boxes was capped at 2200 MHz. Requests up to 131,072 tokens share decode steps. With --kv-format int4 (experimental) the KV pool is 857,600 tokens at the default SHARE_LIMIT of 131,072, an estimate not yet booted.
